title: A power saving for square-difference-free sets
summary: OpenAI 数学仓库收录的研究手稿。展开查看英文摘要，或标记后让我进一步解释。

abstractEnglish: We prove that there are absolute constants c > 0 and C < ∞ such that every set $`A\subseteq\{1,\ldots,N\}`$ with no nonzero square difference satisfies $`|A|\le C N^{1-c}`$. This answers the fixed-power question posed by Green and Sawhney.
